Submitted routing for `01-locate_sources-MOD-IDN`:

- `VAR-countrycode` → `hhdata` (no clear column; likely constant from survey identity/ISO3)
- `VAR-intmonth` → `hhdata.a4` (date de l'interview; parse month)
- `VAR-intyear` → `hhdata.a4` (date de l'interview; parse year)
- `VAR-weight` → `hhdata.hhweight` (Pondération définitive)
- `VAR-year` → `hhdata.a4` (derive survey start year from interview date if needed)

Note: `hhweight` also appears in `hhevdata`, `hhstdata`, and `indata`.
